standard_prerequisites.name: If f is not contained in any minimal prime of a Noetherian local ring of dimension d then dim(R/fR) = d - 1
Every Noetherian local ring admits a system of parameters of length equal to its dimension
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the parameters of R/fR to lift.

core_obligations: Since f lies in no minimal prime of R, the one-equation lemma gives dim(R/fR) = d - 1 (proof lines 38095-38096). Choose a system of parameters g-bar_1, ..., g-bar_{d-1} of R/fR by the dimension proposition and lift them to g_1, ..., g_{d-1} in R (proof lines 38097-38099). The images of f, g_1, ..., g_{d-1} generate an ideal of definition modulo which R/fR has dimension zero, so f, g_1, ..., g_{d-1} is a system of parameters of R; replacing the g_i by their k-th powers preserves the system-of-parameters property and puts them in m^k (proof lines 38100-38104).
proof_roadmap: Drop the dimension via the one-equation lemma and choose parameters of R/fR (proof lines 38095-38099).
Lift to R, verify the system of parameters, and take k-th powers (proof lines 38100-38104).
